top_repos.portability_reason: The reusable C++ algorithms are real, but the full library is analysis-scale and AGPL/Python/third-party heavy, so only narrow kernels are realistic firmware targets.
top_repos.value_reason: Useful as a reference for embedded onset, rhythm, tonal, and level-analysis control signals rather than as a whole synth/effect port.
top_repos.port_idea: Prototype one detector, such as onset or true-peak, as a fixed-buffer sidechain utility on Teensy 4.1 before considering any larger Essentia subsystem.
top_repos.note: New - Useful as a reference for embedded onset, rhythm, tonal, and level-analysis control signals rather than as a whole synth/effect port.
top_repos.summary: C++ library for audio and music analysis, description and synthesis, including Python bindings

top_repos.portability_reason: The DSP headers are well separated, but the project leans on desktop SIMD and GPL licensing, so firmware use should be selective and reference-driven.
top_repos.value_reason: Strong reference implementations for biquads, FIR/IIR filters, oscillators, waveshaping, and sample-rate conversion can improve embedded DSP tests and comparisons.
top_repos.port_idea: Lift or reimplement one scalar filter/SRC block and benchmark it against DaisySP or Teensy Audio before touching the larger KFR framework.
top_repos.note: New - Strong reference implementations for biquads, FIR/IIR filters, oscillators, waveshaping, and sample-rate conversion can improve embedded DSP tests and comparisons.
top_repos.summary: Fast, modern C++ DSP framework, FFT, Sample Rate Conversion, FIR/IIR/Biquad Filters (SSE, AVX, AVX-512, ARM NEON, RISC-V RVV)

top_repos.portability_reason: Header-oriented C++ DSP lives under q_lib/include/q/fx with little UI or plugin coupling in the core paths.
top_repos.value_reason: Adds a coherent portable set of effects, envelopes, math helpers, and audio-rate utilities beyond single-demo embedded examples.
top_repos.port_idea: Start with q::fx delay or envelope in a Daisy callback, then decide whether its fixed-point/math helpers fit the target toolchain.
top_repos.note: Returning - Adds a coherent portable set of effects, envelopes, math helpers, and audio-rate utilities beyond single-demo embedded examples.
top_repos.summary: C++ Library for Audio Digital Signal Processing

top_repos.portability_reason: The library is already organized as small C++ DSP modules for embedded audio callbacks.
top_repos.value_reason: Best used as the portability baseline for judging whether computer-first code adds anything beyond stock Daisy/Teensy blocks.
top_repos.port_idea: Use its oscillator, envelope, drum, and effect modules as reference tests when porting higher-level synth or effect algorithms from this digest.
top_repos.note: New - Best used as the portability baseline for judging whether computer-first code adds anything beyond stock Daisy/Teensy blocks.
top_repos.summary: A Powerful DSP Library in C++

top_repos.portability_reason: The C++ resampler is separated and header-friendly, but quality settings, filter length, and buffering need MCU-specific limits.
top_repos.value_reason: High-quality sample-rate conversion is valuable for sample playback, offline asset prep, and rate-bridging tests on embedded audio devices.
top_repos.port_idea: Constrain filter length and channel count, then test one mono conversion path on Teensy 4.1 with fixed input/output blocks.
top_repos.note: Returning - High-quality sample-rate conversion is valuable for sample playback, offline asset prep, and rate-bridging tests on embedded audio devices.
top_repos.summary: High-quality pro audio resampler / sample rate conversion header-only C++ library. Very fast, for both audio resampling and time-series interpolation.

top_repos.portability_reason: The browser app is not portable as a system, but Rust DSP and wavetable/FM effect modules are separable enough for algorithm extraction.
top_repos.value_reason: The useful payoff is modern wavetable/FM effect design and filter code, not the web DAW shell.
top_repos.port_idea: Translate one oscillator or wavefolder module into C++ for Daisy/Teensy and ignore the browser, database, and worklet infrastructure.
top_repos.note: New - The useful payoff is modern wavetable/FM effect design and filter code, not the web DAW shell.
top_repos.summary: Browser-based DAW and audio synthesis platform with dozens of effects, synths, and modules

top_repos.portability_reason: Small C++ filter headers make this a direct firmware-reference target with little host structure to remove.
top_repos.value_reason: Useful for comparing simple biquad variants and coefficient handling against embedded library filters.
top_repos.port_idea: Port the biquad header into a Teensy Audio test object and measure coefficient update behavior under modulation.
top_repos.note: Returning - Useful for comparing simple biquad variants and coefficient handling against embedded library filters.

top_repos.portability_reason: The JUCE project has a clear Source/DSP core, but firmware use still needs plugin-state, preset, and host assumptions removed.
top_repos.value_reason: The Juno-style oscillator, chorus, VCF, VCA, and envelope headers offer a focused synth-voice extraction target.
top_repos.port_idea: Extract one mono voice with oscillator, ADSR, VCF, and chorus disabled at first, then add chorus after CPU and RAM are measured.
top_repos.note: Returning - The Juno-style oscillator, chorus, VCF, VCA, and envelope headers offer a focused synth-voice extraction target.
top_repos.summary: Linux, Osx & Windows JUCE port of Ultramaster Group's classic 2001 software synth

top_repos.portability_reason: The Faust scripts are small DSP sources that can generate C++ kernels without keeping the experiment scripts or plugin wrappers.
top_repos.value_reason: Good compact source material for generated filters, soft clipping, and experimental effect structures on MCU audio.
top_repos.port_idea: Generate C++ from one Faust effect, wrap it as a mono Daisy/Teensy block, and hard-code a few controls before exposing CV/MIDI.
top_repos.note: New - Good compact source material for generated filters, soft clipping, and experimental effect structures on MCU audio.
top_repos.summary: At the crossroads of programming your own audio effects, and letting your audio effects be programmed for you.

top_repos.portability_reason: This is already Teensy-oriented Arduino code with project-specific dynamic filter files.
top_repos.value_reason: Practical reference for a Teensy audio processor with dynamic filtering rather than a desktop-to-MCU transplant.
top_repos.port_idea: Use the dynamic filter code as a Teensy baseline, then compare a Daisy port only after the control-rate update model is clear.
top_repos.note: New - Practical reference for a Teensy audio processor with dynamic filtering rather than a desktop-to-MCU transplant.
top_repos.summary: A Teensy based DSP audio processor
